notes.title: 1.1.0 Update
notes.content:
A new update is now available for One Night.

[b]New Features[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259773/0f46bacc8ca7f72b5e4966249cc1828ba4649308.jpg[/img]

New in this update is the addition of a hotel room because what eroge situation would be complete without one?

Additionally, it is now possible to change Wakana's outfit during each of the available sex scenes to add more customizable options for the perfect scene. Other options have been added including new transparency options as well as new patterns to these scenes.

The demo has also been updated as well.

As always thank you for your support and please enjoy this update with Wakana this weekend!

[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*]Costume switching added during missionary, doggy style, and cowgirl scenes
[*]Added penis transparency to the Options menu
[*]Added hand transparency to the Options menu
[*]Added the new area, hotel, to the title menu after clearing the game
[*]Added C and D patterns to the obscene pattern
[/list]
